compiled_state.title: As a DSO maintainer, a regression fixture corpus from named bug tickets is replayed in both CI and local paths, and CLAUDE.md rule 11 is updated with the ADR cross-reference
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Build a regression fixture corpus from three named bug tickets, replay it in both CI and local verifier paths at sprint close, verify ≥95% cross-path ruling equivalence, and update CLAUDE.md rule 11 with a one-sentence cross-reference to ADR 0013.

**Why**: The verifier's ruling correctness is probabilistic. The fixture corpus provides empirical anchors from real failure cases. Cross-path equivalence ensures CI and local paths produce consistent rulings — divergence would mean local runs give misleading signals.

**Scope**:
- IN: Regression fixture corpus from ee3a-43fc (PR #102 hallucinated undefined function), b2ef-cd72 (PR #100 severity-inflated important), 9e84-2b78 (.coderabbit.yaml false-positive trust-boundary); replay harness for both CI and local paths; cross-path ruling equivalence verification (≥95%); CLAUDE.md rule 11 one-sentence update pointing to ADR 0013 with four-prong exception scope
- OUT: Verifier agent implementation (S3), dispatch wiring (S4, S5), feature flag (S6), contract docs (S8)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, regression fixture corpus replayed in both CI and local paths with required ruling behavior: `drop` on ee3a-43fc hallucinated undefined-function claims; `downgrade-to-minor` on b2ef-cd72 severity-inflated important; `drop` on 9e84-2b78 .coderabbit.yaml false-positive; defer-rubric ruling on the known-ambiguous case; `drop` on the known-fabricated-evidence case (CI re-execution flips it); `verification_evidence`-required ruling on the known-rephrased absence claim using non-canonical wording
  ← Satisfies: "Regression fixture corpus replayed at sprint close in both CI and local paths"
- When this story is complete, cross-path ruling equivalence is ≥95% identical rulings between CI and local paths across the full corpus
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-path ruling equivalence: ≥95% identical rulings between CI and local paths across the corpus"
- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md rule 11 is updated with one sentence at the end of its existing text cross-referencing `docs/adr/0013-verifier-severity-authority.md` and naming the four-prong exception scope (sub-agent identity, ruling enum, dispatch surface, feature-flag gating)
  ← Satisfies: "CLAUDE.md rule 11 is updated to add a single sentence pointing to docs/adr/0013-verifier-severity-authority.md"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Fixture corpus has no auto-update mechanism — manual curation required as verifier rubric or reviewer prompt evolves
- [Consumer Impact] CLAUDE.md rule 11 governs the autonomous-resolution attempt counter. S6 introduces a cascading-failure brake that holds the counter when verifier failure threshold is exceeded. The rule 11 update must explicitly document this hold behavior and reference ADR 0013, otherwise downstream consumers (resolution sub-agents, oscillation-check, debug-everything) will not know the counter can be paused by a verifier signal. The CLAUDE.md edit must NOT be made directly — emit a `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE` report per doc-router Gate 5 and surface it for user approval before any edit lands.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

comments.body:
CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE

Rule being updated: Rule 11 ("Never override reviewer severity") in the "Never Do These" section of CLAUDE.md

Existing rule text (line 84):
  11. **Never override reviewer severity** — critical->1-2, important->3. Autonomous resolution via DefenseStore (R5; `review-defense-store.sh` locally, `review-github-defense-store.sh` in CI) for up to `review.max_resolution_attempts` (default: 5) attempts; user escalation after. See REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md R1-R5.

Proposed addition (append one sentence to the rule):
  "See `docs/adr/0013-verifier-severity-authority.md` for the four-prong exception scope (sub-agent identity, ruling enum, dispatch surface, feature-flag gating); Rule 11's attempt counter may be paused by the verifier's cascading-failure brake when `verifier_failure_threshold` is exceeded (S6)."

Justification:
  - ADR 0013 governs verifier severity authority — Rule 11 should cross-reference it so agents know the exception scope
  - S6 introduced the cascading-failure brake which can pause the Rule 11 attempt counter; this is load-bearing for autonomous resolution flow
  - Downstream agents need awareness that the verifier (not the orchestrator) may modify severity via downgrade-to-minor and drop rulings

Status: PENDING_USER_APPROVAL — user must approve before CLAUDE.md is edited
